5203.title: Panel tab clicks activate unintended drags
5203.rootCauseOneLine: Independent 4px reorder and 7px split activation plus close-button pointer-down bubbling consume clicks or create unintended panes.
5203.proposedFix: Share the existing 8px reorder tolerance between panel tab reorder and split gestures, and exclude close-button pointer-down from dragging.
5203.caveats: No Chrome/Chromium is installed; real components run with supplied DOM geometry, not a full app or hardware trace. The regression is embedded in the HTML.
